window: 4 AM Mon 2 Nov to 4 AM Mon 9 Nov IST
headline: Ramayana led Hyderabad's week with 3.97M tickets, ahead of Scene at 2.22M, while Scene and Mookuthi Amman 2 gained the most interest.
bullets: Ramayana finished first with 3.97M tickets, up 1374 on the prior week, and its best day was Sat 7 Nov with 1.18M tickets.
Scene placed second with 2.22M tickets, and its best day was Fri 6 Nov with 578K tickets.
Mookuthi Amman 2 was third with 285K tickets over 5 counted days, peaking on Sun 8 Nov with 119K tickets.

Jailer 2 (210K) and Aadarsha Kutumbam (203K) took fourth and fifth, both counted on all 7 days and both down slightly on the prior week, while Scene gained 135K interested users and Ramayana gained 124K.
